NONE: B1 used as a formal and polite way of speaking to a man, especially one who you are providing a service to or who is in a position of authority
先生
› mainly UK sometimes used by children to address or refer to teachers who are men
（孩子對男性教師的稱呼）老師
› Indian English used after the name of a man, especially one who is in a position of authority, in order to be polite or show respect
（用於男性、特別是權威人士的名字之後，用以表示禮貌或尊敬）先生
B2 used to begin a formal letter to a man whose name you do not know. "Dear Sirs" is an old fashioned way of beginning a letter to a company.
尊敬的先生（用於正式信函中稱呼不知姓名的男性收信人；Dear sirs，即尊敬的各位先生，為正式商務信函的舊式信首稱呼語）
› used to begin a formal letter when you do not know if the person you are writing to is a man or a woman
尊敬的先生或女士，敬啓者（用於正式信函中稱呼不知性別的收信人）
› used as the title of a knight (= a man who has been given a rank of honour by a British king or queen), with a first name or with both first and family names, but never with just the family name
爵士（用於名前或姓名前，但不只跟姓連用）

example: Would you like to see the menu, sir?
您要看看菜單嗎，先生?
"Did you hear what I said?" "Yes, Sir."
「聽到我說的話了嗎？」「是的，先生。」
Miss
Ms
Can I go to the toilet, sir?
我可以上廁所嗎，老師？
John Sir
約翰先生

C: › a male parent of an animal, especially a horse
› old use used as a form of address to a king

NONE: › to become the male parent of an animal or the father of a child
（雄性動物）繁殖；成爲（孩子）的父親

example: I will serve you always, sire.
我將永遠爲您效勞，陛下。
The foal was sired by a cup-winning racehorse.
那匹馬的父親是一匹獲得過獎盃的賽馬。
old use or humorous At the age of 70, he married a much younger woman and went on to sire two more children.
70歲時，他和一個比他年輕許多的女子結婚並且又生了兩個孩子。

C: C2 a device for making a loud warning noise
› (in ancient Greek literature) one of the creatures who were half woman and half bird, whose beautiful singing encouraged sailors to sail into dangerous waters where they died
賽蓮（古希臘神話中的海妖）
› a woman who is considered to be very attractive, but also dangerous
妖婦，迷人而危險的女人

example: police sirens
警笛
When the air raid siren went off people ran to their shelters.
空襲警報響起時，人們紛紛跑向掩蔽所。

NONE: › a powerful force that attracts you to something
（某事物）強大的吸引力

example: I responded to the siren call of the road and left home to drive across the country.
我聽從來自道路的呼喚，驅車離家駛往鄉村。

NONE: › the best meat from the lower back of a cow
牛腰肉，牛裡脊肉
› a hot wind that blows from the Sahara Desert to southern Europe
西洛可風（從撒哈拉沙漠吹向歐洲南部的熱風）
› a form of address that shows no respect, used to a man
小子；老兄（用於對男人的輕蔑稱呼）

example: Come here, sirrah!
